svg.title: Verdicts for CVE-2020-14343 per install and SBOM→scanner pair
svg.desc: Three panels (without VEX, with --vex, with vexctl filter); rows are the seven installs, columns the four SBOM generator → scanner pairs. Cells show ✓ when the scan agrees with the oracle, FP or FN otherwise.
